records.title: Construction Accounting Software
records.summary: Abio presents itself as an integrated construction accounting platform that reduces spreadsheets and double entry while giving users real-time business and job-cost visibility.
replatformingImplications: Design Abio NG around integrated workflows rather than isolated accounting screens.
Make job, transaction, document, and dashboard drill-downs first-class navigation patterns.
Use this source for business vocabulary, not exact validation or posting rules.

records.title: About Abio
records.summary: Abio emphasizes long construction-industry experience, customer continuity, scalable implementation, and a commitment to supporting customers over the long term.
replatformingImplications: Prefer modernization choices that protect customer continuity and gradual migration.
Avoid throwing away legacy workflows until equivalent NG workflows are verified.

records.title: Construction Finance
records.summary: Construction Finance centers on company/division financial visibility, budgets, GL control, automated journal support, audit trails, and drill-down to related subledgers/documents.
replatformingImplications: Preserve book/company/division/profit-center dimensions in API contracts.
Keep GL updates and journal automation in server-side command services.
Financial grids should drill down to subledgers and documents.

records.title: Job Costing
records.summary: Job Costing is positioned as the core visibility layer for project health, using real-time costs, budgets, variances, saved views, and analytics to help users identify risk early.
replatformingImplications: Treat Job as a central hub record with deep links to AP, AR, timesheets, POs, documents, and JC transactions.
AG Grid job-cost views should support saved layouts, filtering, grouping, and drill-down.
Job edit/save behavior must remain backed by migrated PowerBuilder program-layer logic.

records.title: Construction Accounts Payable
records.summary: AP focuses on controlling construction expenses, supplier/subcontractor payments, PO integration, document links, invoice scanning/OCR, batch approval, and real-time expense enquiries.
replatformingImplications: Model AP invoice entry, approval, PO matching, and payment as explicit server-side workflows.
Expose linked documents directly from AP transaction screens.
Preserve vendor defaults and streamlined entry behavior from legacy code.

records.title: Construction Invoicing
records.summary: Invoicing covers receivables, claims, progress billing, T&M support, retention, payment tracking, LEMS backup, tax calculation, and posting effects across AR, GL, equipment, jobs, and customers.
replatformingImplications: Invoice generation should be implemented as a command workflow with posting and audit rules.
AR screens should link to LEMS, documents, job, equipment, payments, and client approvals.
Dispute support requires easy access to invoice backup and approval artifacts.

records.title: Subcontractors & Purchase Orders
records.summary: This area organizes subcontractor data, contracts, requisitions, purchase orders, insurance, invoices, holdback, progress payments, taxes, variance orders, approvals, and committed costs.
replatformingImplications: PO and subcontract workflows must update committed costs consistently.
Search should support PO number, inventory item, vendor/subcontractor, and business-specific queries.
Insurance and document expiry tracking should be visible from subcontractor/project contexts.

records.title: Mobile Timesheet Software
records.summary: Timesheets are framed as mobile field entry with supervisor review, rejection correction, payroll integration, job-cost updates, client approval, and invoice support.
replatformingImplications: Timesheet approval/rejection should be modeled as explicit state transitions.
Do not embed payroll or job-cost side effects in Angular; use server-side commands.
Mobile-friendly UI and fast correction workflows are important for adoption.

records.title: Canadian Payroll
records.summary: Payroll emphasizes Canadian and unionized labour requirements, complex earnings and deductions, CRA/union compliance, AP integration for expenses/garnishments, and year-end processing.
replatformingImplications: Payroll calculation logic is high risk and must be migrated from authoritative legacy/database rules.
Union and remittance behavior should be represented as server-side, versioned business logic.
AI help can explain payroll concepts, but must not invent calculation rules.

records.title: Reporting & Analytics
records.summary: Reporting and analytics focus on configurable reports, dashboard metrics, real-time updates, visual summaries, filters, and drill-down into important details.
replatformingImplications: Saved AG Grid layouts and report definitions should be persisted server-side.
Dashboards should link to source records instead of presenting isolated charts.
Report filters should be reusable by AI-assisted search and navigation.

records.title: Document Management for Construction
records.summary: Document management provides secure storage, indexing, tagging, viewer access, permissions, backups, revision history, audit trail, approval routing, and links to business records.
replatformingImplications: Implement documents as a shared platform service across modules.
Use attachment links so documents can be opened from jobs, invoices, POs, requisitions, payments, and reports.
Permissions and audit trail must be enforced on the server.

records.title: Cloud Based Accounting Software
records.summary: Cloud positioning emphasizes browser/tablet access, remote work, managed hosting, backups, upgrades, reduced IT overhead, and scalable data usage.
replatformingImplications: Design Abio NG around browser-first delivery and centralized service hosting.
Authentication, authorization, tenant/book scoping, backups, and uptime are platform concerns.
Mobile-responsive layouts matter for field workflows.

records.title: Privacy Policy
records.summary: The privacy page identifies categories of personal information collected for communication and payment processing, and describes access/correction request handling.
replatformingImplications: AI and logging features should avoid exposing personal/contact/billing data unnecessarily.
Future AI assistant design should account for privacy, access control, and auditability.

crossModuleFlows.designNote: Represent approvals and downstream updates as server-side business commands.
Committed-cost updates must be transactional and auditable.
Documents should be a shared service with related-record links and permission checks.

goodUses: Map user questions to likely screens or workflows
Help onboard users to Abio NG concepts
